review_scope: Primary dataset documentation reviewed through the browser; no new raw corpus downloaded or independently annotated.

candidates.name: HelpSteer2
candidates.documented_strength: Generated responses from multiple models with independent contractor ratings; an individual-rating release is available.
candidates.gap: No human-written response comparison and a different quality rubric. Selected/filtered ratings are not this study's independent annotation audit. Collection is not a representative 2026 web sample.
candidates.decision: Potential auxiliary generated-quality study only; not accepted as the required joint corpus.

candidates.name: ELLIPSE
candidates.documented_strength: Learner essays with proficiency scores, a rubric, and a separately released raw-rater file.
candidates.gap: Proficiency is not the proposed content-quality construct; essays are not a diverse contemporary web sample. Young writers and demographic fields require careful minimization and permitted-use review.
candidates.decision: Potential separately governed proficiency challenge; not accepted as low-quality ground truth.

candidates.name: MAGE
candidates.documented_strength: Human and generated text across source datasets, generators, and distribution-shift testbeds.
candidates.gap: No matched independent annotations for this quality rubric. Processed data filter low-quality texts; inherited text rights need per-source review. Its origin coding is reversed relative to this project.
candidates.decision: Potential origin-only auxiliary benchmark, not a substitute for the proposed quality-labeled evaluation.

limitations: Documentation review is not a provenance audit, permission adjudication, or consent verification for individual texts. No final dataset is claimed to exist.
